headline: PhantomCore malware delivered via TrueConf Server exploitation using CVE-2026-72529/72530
summary: Attackers are compromising unpatched TrueConf Servers to replace official client installers with PhantomCore-infected versions, spreading malware to conference participants.
details: Attackers are actively exploiting two vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-72529 and CVE-2026-72530, to compromise unpatched TrueConf Servers. This allows them to replace legitimate client installers with versions infected with PhantomCore malware.

The compromised installers then spread the infection to devices of conference participants. Organizations using on-premises TrueConf infrastructure must not only update their servers but also verify the integrity of previously distributed clients.

These vulnerabilities should be treated as critical Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) items for organizations globally. It is crucial to track not only TrueConf servers but also any participant devices that downloaded a tampered installer.

To mitigate the risk, users should update to fixed versions of TrueConf Server and restrict port 4307/TCP. Additionally, verify the integrity of the web root and distribution files to ensure no malicious alterations.
If any warnings or suspicious behavior occur after a TrueConf update, users are advised not to run it again and to contact their administrator immediately for assistance.

headline: Grok Bot is an all-new iPhone and Mac app from SpaceXAI and Cursor
summary: SpaceXAI and Cursor, currently merging, are jointly releasing Grok Bot for iPhone and Mac. This marks their first major product launch together.
details: SpaceXAI and Cursor are reportedly launching a new application called Grok Bot for iPhone and Mac. This release comes as the two companies are in the process of merging into a single entity.

Grok Bot is described as an 'all-new' app, suggesting it offers novel features or a unique approach to AI on Apple platforms. Its availability on both iPhone and Mac indicates a cross-device experience.
